description: This file defines a minimal API endpoint class CatalogBrandListEndpoint for listing CatalogBrand entities in an ASP.NET Core application. It leverages dependency injection, AutoMapper for object mapping, and repositories for data access.

classes.name: CatalogBrandListEndpoint
classes.description: A minimal API endpoint class that provides a route for listing catalog brands by querying a repository and returning a mapped response.

methods.name: AddRoute
methods.description: Establishes the HTTP GET route at 'api/catalog-brands' and links it to the handler method.

methods.name: HandleAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a list of CatalogBrand entities, maps them to DTOs, and returns them wrapped in a response object.
